subject: design/plangate-carina-adapter
statement: `plangate project` takes a `--tracker gh|carina` flag (default `gh`); `cmd/plangate/main.go` constructs the chosen adapter at the projection boundary (replacing the hardcoded `tracker.GH`). The Carina adapter takes a store-location option (`--carina-root`, default the repo's bucket-1 work-items root); the `gh` path is unchanged when unselected. Everything upstream of the `Tracker` interface — decomposition, sizing, the plan fold, the report — is untouched (DINV-1). Flag names fix at implementation (shape).
